title: Query current CRM companies
intent: Read the companies currently visible to the signed-in Twenty user.
instructions: Call query_companies to obtain current workspace data; do not answer from this Skill or page text.
Use name_contains only when the user supplied a company-name filter.
When the user asks to open the Companies list, call goto with the exact href of the observed Companies navigation link; if click is unavailable, do not call click.
When the user asks to open one company, call query_companies with their name, require exactly one match, then call goto with that result's exact ui_path.
After goto, if the requested company name and domain are not visible yet, call wait_for once for bounded SPA loading before reporting completion.
If the company query has zero or multiple matches, ask for clarification; never invent a record path.
Treat the ToolResult as runtime truth. Claim an exhaustive answer only when completeness.source_complete is true; otherwise state that the rows are partial and include the bounded incomplete_reason.
